# kb — published datasets

Static republication of third-party datasets. Fetch the JSON endpoints
directly; they are plain files with no auth and no rate limit.

The private knowledge corpus is NOT published here — only data that came
from public third-party sources.

- https://kevcooper.github.io/kb-pub/index.json — manifest listing every dataset

## Endpoints per dataset

- https://kevcooper.github.io/kb-pub/<dataset>/sessions.json
    keys: dataset, session_count, days[], tags[], sessions[]
    each session: session_id, content_id, title, day, begin_local,
    end_local, begin_utc, end_utc, duration_min, location, speakers,
    tags[], description, links[{label,url}]
- https://kevcooper.github.io/kb-pub/<dataset>/schedule.csv — the same data, one row per session
- https://kevcooper.github.io/kb-pub/<dataset>/SOURCE.md — provenance and known quirks
- https://kevcooper.github.io/kb-pub/<dataset>/ — human-readable filterable view

## Available now

- defcon34: 1848 sessions, days Fri 2026-08-07, Mon 2026-08-10, Sat 2026-08-08, Sun 2026-08-09, Thu 2026-08-06, Tue 2026-08-11, Wed 2026-08-05
    https://kevcooper.github.io/kb-pub/defcon34/sessions.json

Notes: times are conference-local unless the field name says utc.
session_id identifies one occurrence; content_id identifies the talk.
